{{Quote|Wanted dead for extortion. Terminate with extreme prejudice.|Kahleeko Sik's bounty brief|<ref name="SW:BH" />}}
'''Kahleeko Sik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] gang-affiliated extortion kingpin from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], an anonymous entity posted a 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for the criminal. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Sik spent time at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] him after a firefight and claimed the bounty.

==Biography==
Kahleeko Sik was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="SW:BH" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SW:BH" /> An extortion kingpin, he<ref name="BHGuide" /> was affiliated with [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] and [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] street gangs.<ref name="SW:BH" /> At some point by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date2">''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'' is set immediately after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> a 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed on Sik, as he wanted [[Death/Legends|dead]] for extortion by an anonymous originator. His last known location was the<ref name="SW:BH" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="CL" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and he was listed to be exterminated with "extreme prejudice."<ref name="SW:BH" /> 

In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date2" /> Sik was spent time on a balcony inside<ref name="SW:BH" /> the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="FF44">{{FactFile|44|COR 21-22|Coruscant &ndash; Outlander Club}}</ref> While the Kadas'sa'Nikto stood alone, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] entered the club in [[Mission to Coruscant (The Hunt)|pursuit]] of [[drug dealer]] [[Jervis Gloom]].<ref name="SW:BH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Sik was identified as a bounty by Fett, who used his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] to access the balcony. Upon catching sight of the hunter, Sik began shooting at him. Fett, however, was able to kill the Kadas'sa'Nikto and claim the 4,000 credits.<ref name="SW:BH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Sik had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SW:BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kahleeko Sik first appeared in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''.<ref name="SW:BH" /> He is the fifteenth optional bounty in the "Entertainment District" area and the fortieth optional bounty overall.<ref name="BHGuide" />
